dialogue.origin: こんにちは。担当の相談員です。本日はどのようなご相談になりますか？
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm your counselor for today. What would you like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 夫と将来の事で悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm worried about the future with my husband.

dialogue.origin: これからというかか
dialogue.content: About the future, I mean.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 詳しくお聞かせいただきたいので質問してもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: To get a better understanding, would it be alright if I asked you some questions?

dialogue.origin: はいおねがいします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。現在の生活はどういった感じでお過ごしされていますか？家族構成とか・・・
dialogue.content: Thank you. Could you tell me a little about your current life? Your family situation, for example...

dialogue.origin: 夫と幼稚園年長の娘が一人います
dialogue.content: I have a husband and a daughter who is in her last year of kindergarten.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 3月に夫が役職定年しまして
dialogue.content: In March, my husband reached the mandatory retirement age for his managerial position.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 次の人生を探しています
dialogue.content: He's looking for the next chapter in his life.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 夫婦ともに薬剤師なので
dialogue.content: We are both pharmacists,

dialogue.origin: 夫は二人で調剤薬局をやりたいようで
dialogue.content: and my husband wants the two of us to open a dispensing pharmacy together.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・
dialogue.content: I understand...

dialogue.origin: その話が進み出しそうなのですが
dialogue.content: It looks like that plan is starting to move forward,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: だんだん不安になってきていまい
dialogue.content: but I'm gradually becoming more and more anxious about it.

dialogue.origin: それで大丈夫なのかなと
dialogue.content: wondering if it's really okay.

dialogue.origin: そうお感じになれれtるのですね。。。
dialogue.content: So that's how you're feeling...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんといろいろとお話し進める中でどんな点が不安に感じられましたか？
dialogue.content: As you've been discussing this with your husband, what aspects of it have made you feel anxious?

dialogue.origin: 子供がまだ小さいので
dialogue.content: Our child is still young,

dialogue.origin: わたしが仕事をすることに抵抗があります
dialogue.content: so I'm reluctant to go back to work.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・現在はあなたは仕事はされてはいないのですね
dialogue.content: I see... So you aren't currently working, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい4年ほどしていませんでも、まだ小さいからこれからもどんどんお金がかかるので働かなくてはいけないことはわかっているのですが
dialogue.content: Yes, I haven't worked for about four years. But I understand that as she grows, expenses will keep increasing, so I know I have to work.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・たしかに気持ちが揺らいでしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... It's certainly understandable that you'd feel conflicted...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 自営業になることも不安です
dialogue.content: I'm also anxious about becoming self-employed.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・その今お話しにあがったあなたの不安点については夫さんはなんと？お話しされていますか？
dialogue.content: I see... Regarding the anxieties you just mentioned, what has your husband said about them?

dialogue.origin: はっきり伝えていません
dialogue.content: I haven't told him clearly.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね・・・もんもんとおひとりで悩んでいる感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... So it sounds like you've been brooding over this on your own?

dialogue.origin: そうですね夫がずっとやりたいと言っていることなので
dialogue.content: Yes. It's something my husband has wanted to do for a long time,

dialogue.origin: 今更やめようとは言えないかなと
dialogue.content: so I feel like I can't tell him to stop at this point.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。。
dialogue.content: I understand...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたの娘さんは今年長さんと言う事ですが例えばあなたが調剤薬局で仕事をする場合にはどなたかの支援や社会的支援（児童館や延長保育など）の助けは受けられそうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned your daughter is in her last year of kindergarten. If you were to work at the pharmacy, would you be able to get any support, either from family or social services like after-school care or extended daycare?

dialogue.origin: そうですね営業の終了時間までは厳しいですが、支援は受けられると思いますとなりに、夫の両親も暮らしています
dialogue.content: Let's see... It would be hard to cover the hours all the way until closing, but I think we could get some support. My husband's parents also live next door.

dialogue.origin: 今のところ物理的には大丈夫す
dialogue.content: For now, logistically it should be manageable.

dialogue.origin: ただ両親も高齢なので
dialogue.content: But my in-laws are elderly,

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。。近くにいらっしゃるのは心強いですね。でもご両親が高齢だとあまり負担はかけられないと思ってしまますよね。。。
dialogue.content: I see... It must be reassuring to have them nearby. But with them being elderly, you probably feel you can't burden them too much...

dialogue.origin: しまいますよね。の間違いでした。すみません。
dialogue.content: I meant 'you feel that way, right?' My apologies, I misspoke.

dialogue.origin: はいなるべくかけたくないです。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'd like to avoid burdening them as much as possible.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。。。
dialogue.content: Of course.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは役職定年とのことですがそうなるとかなり人脈や信頼がおありのように思いましたが自営業をするにあたっては資金面などの不安が大きい感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned your husband retired from a managerial position. I imagine he has built up a lot of connections and trust. When it comes to being self-employed, is your anxiety more about the financial side of things?

dialogue.origin: 年齢が55歳ですのでこれからずっと健康なのかなとか
dialogue.content: He's 55, so I worry about whether he'll stay healthy from now on.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 今はお金は退職金も出てありますが
dialogue.content: For now, we have funds, including his retirement payout,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 薬局を開けば無くなってしまいますし
dialogue.content: but opening a pharmacy would use it all up.

dialogue.origin: 家のローンも30年ぐらい残ってます
dialogue.content: And we still have about 30 years left on our mortgage.

dialogue.origin: わたしも50歳近くていろいろ不安です
dialogue.content: I'm almost 50 myself, and I have various anxieties.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。開所には資金かかりますものね。。。いろいろ家のローンのことや娘さんの教育資金など悩みどころですよね・・・ましてや年齢的な問題もありますものね・・・
dialogue.content: I see. It certainly costs a lot to start a business... There are many things to worry about, like the mortgage and your daughter's education funds... Not to mention the issues that come with age...

dialogue.origin: はいまだまだ終わらないと言う感じです
dialogue.content: Yes, it feels like it's far from over.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。。。まだまだこれからが勝負といった感じですよね。
dialogue.content: Right... It feels like the real challenge is still ahead of you.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: このお話はとても大切な問題だと思いました。これからの人生設計の大切な根幹になるものですものね。
dialogue.content: I feel this is a very important issue. It's the foundation of your life plan from here on out.

dialogue.origin: はいとても大切なこととはわかっているのですが・・・・
dialogue.content: Yes, I know it's very important, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 自分は前向きになれていないのが
dialogue.content: The fact that I can't be positive about it...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 申し訳ないような気がしています
dialogue.content: makes me feel guilty.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。。夫さんに対し、申し訳ないようにお感じになられているのですね。。。それもまたお辛いですよね。。。
dialogue.content: I see... You feel guilty towards your husband... That must be painful for you as well...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに
dialogue.content: By the way,

dialogue.origin: その調剤薬局開所のお話は今どの程度まで具体的に進んでいる感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How far along are the concrete plans for opening the pharmacy?

dialogue.origin: 医師の先生とお話ができて意気投合できそうな感じと言うところです
dialogue.content: He's spoken with a doctor, and it seems like they've hit it off.

dialogue.origin: でも、場所が少し問題で
dialogue.content: But the location is a bit of a problem.

dialogue.origin: 薬局の場所ですね？
dialogue.content: The location for the pharmacy, you mean?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今ですと医療機関からちょっと離れる可能性があって
dialogue.content: As it is now, there's a chance it will be a little far from the medical facility.

dialogue.origin: まぁ。。。そうなのですね、離れてしまうのですね。。。
dialogue.content: Oh... I see, so it would be far away...

dialogue.origin: それでも先送りするよりも今始めることが良いのではないかと夫は考えています
dialogue.content: Even so, my husband thinks it's better to start now rather than postpone it.

dialogue.origin: まぁ。。。そうなんですね。。。でもせっかく開所するなら近隣にこしたことはないですよね。
dialogue.content: Oh... I see... But if you're going to open one, it would be best to be nearby, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: 患者さんにとってはより近くの方が利便性が良いですものね。。。
dialogue.content: It's more convenient for patients if it's closer...

dialogue.origin: はいそうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.origin: できるだけ近い場所に開所できそうな可能性もあるかんじでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is there any possibility you could open it in a closer location?

dialogue.origin: でも開くかもしれない土地は相続次第なので、いつなのかははっきりしませんし
dialogue.content: Well, the land where we might be able to open is dependent on an inheritance, so we don't know when that will be.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。。。それは残念ですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... That's unfortunate...

dialogue.origin: まずは今スタートして土地が空いたら引っ越しすると考えています
dialogue.content: His plan is to start now, and then move when the land becomes available.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。。。。２段構えで行こうとのお考えなのですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... So he's thinking of it as a two-step plan...

dialogue.origin: はいそのくらい本人の気持ちは、今盛り上がっています
dialogue.content: Yes, that's how enthusiastic he is about it right now.

dialogue.origin: 盛り上がっているのですね。。。。うーん。それもまた悩ましいですね。。。ちなみに夫さんはその調剤薬局を何名の薬剤師でまわすお考えでしょうか？あなた以外の採用もありなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: He's very enthusiastic... Hmm. That makes it even more difficult... By the way, how many pharmacists is your husband thinking of running the pharmacy with? Is hiring someone other than you an option?

dialogue.origin: いろいろ考えているようですが、現実的にはまずは薬剤師は夫と私の二人で、事務職の方を1から2名考えています
dialogue.content: He has various ideas, but realistically we'd start with just the two of us as pharmacists, and hire one or two administrative staff.

dialogue.origin: 薬剤師を採用するのはそれはそれで費用がかかるので不安です
dialogue.content: Hiring another pharmacist would be expensive, so that's another worry.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。。たしかにそうですよね。。。あなたありきでのスタートとなると夫さんはお子様のことはあなた以外の支援でカバーしようとお考えなのですね。。。
dialogue.content: I see... That makes sense. If the plan is built around you being involved, your husband is thinking of covering childcare with support from others, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい、そのつもりだと思います。でもそうなると私の負担が大きく感じてしまい子供のことも気になってしまい
dialogue.content: Yes, I think that's his intention. But if that's the case, I feel the burden on me would be too great, and I'd be worried about our child.

dialogue.origin: そうお感じになられるのも当然ですよね。お子様は調剤薬局開所のことは年長さんですがお話とかはしていますか？
dialogue.content: It's completely understandable to feel that way. Your daughter is in her final year of kindergarten—have you talked with her about opening the pharmacy?

dialogue.origin: ぜんぜんしていないです
dialogue.content: Not at all.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 2歳までは、保育園に預けて働いていたのですが、大変でした。
dialogue.content: Until she was two, I put her in daycare and worked, but it was very hard.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。頑張られたのですね。。。
dialogue.content: I see. You must have worked very hard.

dialogue.origin: はいでも、一度やめてみたら子供と一緒にいられて、良かったなと思うようになりました。
dialogue.content: Yes, but once I quit, I was able to be with my child, and I realized how nice it was.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。お子さんの日々の成長を自分の目と手で実感できる日々ですものね。余計に不安感が募りますよね。。。
dialogue.content: That makes sense. Being able to witness and be part of your child's daily growth firsthand is precious—and it can make the worries feel even stronger.

dialogue.origin: はい子供のことが一番気がかりです
dialogue.content: Yes, my child is my biggest concern.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。。。お子様のことがやっぱり一番大切だとお考えなのですね。
dialogue.content: I understand... So you feel that your child is what's most important to you.

dialogue.origin: そうですね高齢で授かったせいか、大事にしたいと思ってしまいます
dialogue.content: Yes. Maybe because we had her when we were older, I just want to cherish her.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。子は何者にも代えがたい宝ですものね。。。
dialogue.content: Of course. A child is an irreplaceable treasure...

dialogue.origin: そうですねとても大切な存在です
dialogue.content: Yes, she is very precious to me.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。そのお子様のこれからもかかわってくる大切な問題ですものね。
dialogue.content: That's right. And this is an important issue that will affect your child's future as well.

dialogue.origin: ここで少し私からご相談の内容をまとめてもよろしかったでしょうか？
dialogue.content: At this point, would it be alright if I summarized what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: はいお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: あなたは役職定年した夫の夢（調剤薬局開所）についてふたつの不安を抱えておられ
dialogue.content: You have two main anxieties about your husband's dream of opening a pharmacy after his mandatory retirement from his position.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ひとつ目の不安は自営業としてこれからしっかりやっていけるのかという不安であり医師との話で今が開設のチャンスととらえて医療機関と少し離れている場所で薬局を開設する段階まできていること
dialogue.content: The first is the anxiety of whether you can make it as a self-employed business, especially as the plan is moving forward to open in a location a little far from the medical facility because he sees this as the right time to start, based on his talk with the doctor.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 二つ目は調剤薬局を開設するとなれば当面は夫さんとあなたの2人体制でまわさなければならなくなり、お子様の保育面子育て面で不安が残るという不安でいらっしゃる。。。いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: The second is that if you open the pharmacy, it will have to be run by just the two of you for the time being, which leaves you with anxieties about childcare and raising your child... Does that sound right?

dialogue.origin: はいそうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: さらにこの２つの不安をご自分では「前向きではない」「夫の夢を応援できなくて申し訳ない」とどこかでご自身をも責めるようにお感じなってお辛くなっている・・・いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Furthermore, because of these two anxieties, you feel you're 'not being positive' and 'feel guilty for not being able to support my husband's dream,' and you're blaming yourself somewhere, which is making you suffer... Is that how it is?

dialogue.origin: はいそうですよね簡単に夫の開局を否定できない気持ちです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. I feel I can't just simply reject my husband's plan to open the pharmacy.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。。。夫さんの長年の夢であるわけですものね。。。しかも夫さんの夢にはあなたの存在なしでは実現できないという感じですものね。。。
dialogue.content: I understand... It's his long-held dream, after all... And it seems like his dream can't be realized without you...

dialogue.origin: はいそう感じています
dialogue.content: Yes, that's how I feel.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・・ここで私からあなたの少しでもお力になりたいのでお伝えさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか。。。
dialogue.content: I see... At this point, I'd like to help you in any way I can, so may I share a thought with you?

dialogue.origin: はいお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: あなたは薬剤師という人を助ける素晴らしい資格をお持ちで、お子さんが2歳までは保育園に預けながらお仕事をなさってきた頑張り屋さんです。そんなあなたは今、一番お子様が大切な存在であるという事に日々気づいてお暮しになっておられる。夫さんの夢も同時に協力したいという両方のお気持ちがありゆえに苦しんで悩んでいる。。。そこで
dialogue.content: You hold a wonderful qualification as a pharmacist—someone who helps others—and you're a hard worker who worked while your child was in daycare until age two. Now you live each day aware that your child is your top priority. You want to support your husband's dream while also honoring that priority, and that is why you're struggling. So...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたから一度夫さんにゆっくり時間を作ってもらいお子さんが保育園（幼稚園）やまたはこれから小学校に言っている時間帯は薬局で仕事をするようにしてあとはパートさんであなたの仕事を担当してはもらえないか？を提案なさってみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How about you ask your husband to set aside some time to talk, and you propose an idea? That you would work at the pharmacy during the hours your child is at kindergarten or, later, elementary school, and ask if he could have a part-timer cover your work for the rest of the time.

dialogue.origin: そうですよねきちんと時間をはっきりさせて話をすれば良いですよね
dialogue.content: You're right. If we clarify the hours and talk it through, that would be good.

dialogue.origin: ただ、夕方だけ働いてくれる薬剤師は正直見つかりにくいです
dialogue.content: However, to be honest, it's hard to find a pharmacist who will only work in the evenings.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。。。難しいのですね。。。
dialogue.content: I see... So that would be difficult...

dialogue.origin: 事務の方に手伝ってもらって夫ひとりで頑張ってもらえるかと言うところでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I wonder if he could manage by himself with help from the clerical staff?

dialogue.origin: 話のきっかけにはなりそうな気がします
dialogue.content: I think it could be a starting point for the conversation.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。たしかに事務の方の協力をもらえればなんとか夫さんで乗り切ってくれると良いのですが。。。
dialogue.content: Yes. It would be great if he could manage with the help of the clerical staff...

dialogue.origin: それを伝えてみれば、私の思いも伝えられそうな気がします。
dialogue.content: If I suggest that, I feel I might be able to convey my own feelings.

dialogue.origin: 提案ならしやすいですよね
dialogue.content: It's easier to present it as a proposal, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。。。提案というと良いかもしれないですよね。。。ありがとうございます。このままあなたの不安を抱えたまま話だけが進んでしまうのはとても夫婦として悲しいと感じましたしまたお子さんにとっても母親はとても大きな存在ですものね
dialogue.content: Yes... Framing it as a proposal might be a good idea... Thank you. I felt it would be very sad for you as a couple if the plan moved forward while you were still holding onto these anxieties. And for your child, a mother is such an important presence.

dialogue.origin: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: あなたが悩んでいたり不安になっていたりするとお子様はきっとわかると思います。
dialogue.content: I'm sure your child can tell when you are worried or anxious.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね結構神経質な子なので心配しています
dialogue.content: You're right. She's quite a sensitive child, so I am worried.

dialogue.origin: それだったら敏感できっとわかってしまいますよね。ご夫婦で何でも話し合い意見を尊重しながら協力しあう姿をお子さんは見ています。
dialogue.content: In that case, being sensitive, she would surely notice. Your child is watching how you and your husband talk things over, respect each other's opinions, and cooperate.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね夫婦間で協力し合う姿は見せたいですね提案ですね前向きな感じがします
dialogue.content: That's true. I do want to show her a model of us cooperating as a couple. A proposal... yes, that feels positive.

dialogue.origin: そう感じで頂けて良かったです。おふたりが力を合わせ患者さんを助ける薬剤師として働く姿を見せられたらきっと一番の教育になるかも知れませんよね。
dialogue.content: I'm glad you feel that way. If you can show her the two of you working together as pharmacists to help patients, that might be the best education of all.

dialogue.origin: そうですねそうありたいです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's how I want it to be.

dialogue.origin: 頑張ってみます
dialogue.content: I will give it a try.

dialogue.origin: あなたならきっとなれると思いました。高齢で授かった大切なお子様ですもの。どれだけ可愛いか。。。大切か。。。そのためにもまずご自身の健康に気を付けて笑顔で頑張っていただけたら私も嬉しいです。
dialogue.content: I'm sure you can do it. She is your precious child, whom you had later in life. How dear... how precious she must be... For her sake, too, please take care of your own health first and do your best with a smile. That would make me happy too.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.
